Allergen introduction

Tofu strips

Sült tofu

6 months+ Sound idea 10 min 2 portions

A first soy food from 6 months. Try the first taste in the morning, on a day your child is well. Once soy is tolerated, keep offering it a few times a week.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 60 g unsalted firm tofu (a first soy food; no soy sauce)
  • 1 tsp rapeseed or olive oil (to warm the tofu, not to fry it hard)

Allergens

soy

Method

  1. Cut the tofu into soft finger strips, or crumble it.
  2. Warm the strips in the oil until hot.
  3. Or stir the crumble into a warm purée.
  4. Check that a strip squashes easily between finger and thumb.
  5. Serve with no soy sauce.

Sound idea

Soy sauce is a salty condiment, not a first soy food.

Warm unsalted firm tofu in a little oil as soft strips, or crumble it into a purée. Use no soy sauce.
